# Agent X402 Paywall MCP

> HTTP 402 + on-chain settlement — pay-per-call for agents

`agent-x402-paywall-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install agent-x402-paywall-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx agent-x402-paywall-mcp
```

## Tools

- `list_supported_chains` — List on-chain settlement options + min-confirmation windows.
- `build_402_challenge`
- `verify_payment`
- `estimate_settlement_cost`
- `get_payment` — Retrieve a verified payment record.
- `list_recent_payments` — List recent verified payments for monitoring.
